scripts.dev: concurrently "vite dev" "nodemon --watch src --ext ts,js,svelte --exec 'echo [API] Server files changed - hot reload enabled'" "npm run dev:test"
scripts.setup:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('.env')){fs.writeFileSync('.env','# Your Google Cloud Project
GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT_ID=your-project-id
GOOGLE_CLOUD_BUCKET_NAME=your-bucket-name

# OAuth (Get from Google Cloud Console)
VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com
VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=your-client-secret

# Authentication (Optional - auto-detects)
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/your/credentials.json
'); console.log('✅ .env created! Update with your credentials then run: bun run dev');} else {console.log('✅ .env already exists! Run: bun run dev');}"
